article.title: Why a High Conversion Rate Can Still Be a Bad Campaign Result
article.why: Judge campaigns by incrementality and economics, not conversion rate alone.

paragraphs.en:
A campaign with a high conversion rate can look successful immediately. If 5 percent of targeted customers buy while the usual customer conversion rate is only 1 percent, the campaign appears excellent. But this comparison can be misleading because the targeted customers may have been selected precisely because they were already much more likely to buy.

Suppose an AI model identifies high-propensity customers. Five percent of the treatment group purchases after receiving an email. Without a proper control group, we do not know how many would have purchased anyway. If 4.7 percent of comparable untreated customers also purchase, the incremental lift is only 0.3 percentage points. Most observed conversions cannot be attributed to the campaign.

This distinction separates response from incrementality. Propensity models are good at finding people likely to produce the outcome, but the people most likely to buy are not always the people most likely to be persuaded. Some are ‘sure things’ who buy with or without contact. Others may be persuadable and generate a larger treatment effect despite having a lower baseline purchase probability.

A randomized control group provides a clean benchmark when implemented correctly. Treatment and control should come from the same eligible population and follow consistent assignment rules. The difference in outcome rates estimates the average incremental effect of the treatment under the experiment.

Economics adds another layer. Even a statistically positive lift may not create value if contact costs, discounts, points, creative costs, or operational expenses exceed incremental margin. A campaign that produces 1,000 extra purchases at 500 yen margin each creates 500,000 yen of incremental contribution before campaign costs. If the campaign costs 800,000 yen, higher conversion does not make it profitable.

Scale matters as well. A small high-score segment may have excellent conversion but limited total opportunity. A broader segment with lower conversion could generate more incremental profit if the treatment effect remains positive and marginal contact cost is low. Capacity constraints and channel fatigue can change the optimal targeting threshold.

Analysts should therefore report several layers together: treatment conversion, control conversion, absolute and relative lift, incremental conversions, incremental revenue or margin, cost, and confidence intervals. Segment-level results can show where the campaign actually creates value.

There are also guardrails. Extra messages may increase unsubscribe rates, complaints, or customer fatigue. A short-term conversion gain can damage future engagement. These outcomes belong in the evaluation even if they are not the primary KPI.

The key question is not ‘How many targeted customers bought?’ It is ‘How many additional desirable outcomes did the campaign cause, and was their value greater than the cost and side effects?’ Once that question becomes the center of evaluation, conversion rate becomes one useful metric rather than the final verdict.
paragraphs.zh:
高conversion rate不一定代表campaign有效，因為targeted customers可能本來就很會買。若treatment conversion為5%，但相似control已有4.7%，incremental lift只有0.3 percentage points。Propensity找的是「容易發生outcome的人」，不一定是「容易被施策改變的人」。

應使用同一eligible population的randomized control比較treatment與control，並進一步計算incremental conversions、revenue/margin與campaign cost。即使lift顯著，若discount、points、contact與operation cost超過增量margin，仍可能不划算。也需看unsubscribe、complaint與fatigue等guardrails。真正問題是campaign造成多少額外desired outcomes，以及價值是否高於成本與副作用。
paragraphs.ja:
高いconversion rateだけではcampaign成功とは言えません。targeted customerがもともと購入しやすい場合、treatment 5％でもcontrolが4.7％ならincremental liftは0.3ポイントです。Propensity modelが見つける「購入しやすい人」と、施策で行動が変わる「persuadableな人」は同じとは限りません。

同じeligible populationからrandomized controlを作り、treatment/control差、incremental conversion、revenue/margin、costを確認します。liftがpositiveでもdiscount、point、contact costが増分marginを上回れば採算は悪化します。unsubscribeやfatigueなどguardrailも含め、「施策が何件の追加成果を生み、その価値がcostと副作用を上回ったか」を評価します。

vocabulary.usage: High propensity is not high uplift.
Do not attribute all conversions to treatment.

business.term: We should evaluate incremental margin versus control, not treatment conversion in isolation.
business.explanation: 把campaign評價從單純CVR轉向增量利益。

sources: Randomized controlled experiments; uplift modeling; incremental campaign measurement.
